tool.title: List merge requests (GitLab)
tool.description: List the open merge requests of the current checkout's GitLab project, optionally only those from one branch.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Only proposals whose source branch is this.

outputs.name: proposals
outputs.description: One line per open change proposal: number, title, source branch.

selection.when: The change proposals live on GitLab — the checkout's remote is a GitLab project.
selection.limits: GitLab only. For a GitHub repository use `github-pr-list`.
selection.cost: `glab`, authenticated (`glab auth login` or `GITLAB_TOKEN`), and one API round trip per call.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitLab API another way. A self-managed GitLab answers on its own host, which this record cannot name; `glab` reaches it once `glab auth login --hostname` has been run for that host.
